# David Rydberg

> Founder building with AI all day. Agents, automations, code, experiments. I share what I'm trying, what works, and what breaks.

This site is a portal to David Rydberg's work. It is a work in progress by design.

## Pages

- /: who David is, where he posts, what he is building, how to reach him.
- /builds: one living page per project. Each Build has a Why, a Stack, and a Log of dated entries tagged TRIED, WORKS, BROKE, SHIPPED, PARKED, DEAD or NOTE.
